lines.text: Ishmael comes to Mizpah with ten men, eats a meal with Gedaliah, then strikes him down with the sword.
Eighty men from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria bring offerings for the house of the LORD, and Ishmael meets them weeping.
Ishmael slaughters most of the men and fills a cistern King Ahab made for fear of Baasha.
Ishmael takes Mizpah's people captive toward the Philistines, but Johanan finds him at Gibeon and the captives join Johanan.
Johanan leads the recovered remnant to Geruth Chimham near Bethlehem, planning to go to Egypt because they fear the Chaldeans.
